newsitem.title: USA: Wasatch Internatl names new president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Wasatch Internatl names new president, CEO.

text.p: Wasatch International Corp said Wednesday that company President and Director Wallace Giakas has resigned to "pursue other interests."
Joe Logan was appointed president, chief executive and director of the company.
The company did not say where Logan worked most recently. It was not clear if Giakas or another person previously held the title of chief executive.
Neither Logan nor the company could be reached immediately for comment.
